atoms.text: This level includes mentions of uncomfortable situations both at school and at home. If this level upsets you, you should speak with an adult about it.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Duncan is waiting for his dad to pick him up. Outside the school gate, a woman he doesn’t know approaches him. She tells him that she would like him to follow her home so that she can give him some chocolate.

atoms.a: Should Duncan go with the stranger?

b: ++He should walk back into school to find a teacher.
He should ask the stranger more questions about herself.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Alex is playing an online game. She receives a message from a user that she does not know. The message says “Hi, I am Tilly. I am 10 years old and looking for new friends. Would you like to meet me in the park tomorrow?”

atoms.a: Should Alex go to the park?

b: She should message back explaining that she is busy.
++She should block the user who sent the message.

feedback.wrong: It is better not to reply to strangers online.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Steph is messaging friends on their laptop. They receive a photo from a stranger that upsets them.

atoms.a: Should Steph message the stranger back?

b: ++They should report the user who sent the photo.

feedback.wrong: It is important not to just ignore messages or photos that upset you. You should do something about it!
